versions.changelog: v1.0.0: hands-on playbook for LLM application quality evaluation and regression testing - evaluation landscape and metrics (correctness, relevance, faithfulness, hallucination rate, robustness, efficiency), test-set construction (golden sets, adversarial samples, size estimation), RAG evaluation (RAGAS four metrics), hallucination detection and measurement, prompt regression testing with gates and drift detection, model comparison and selection with cost-quality trade-off and A-B testing, evaluation pipeline and reporting templates with launch gates; 5-command zero-dependency toolkit
